rationale: VERSION 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0: replaced the tuple/fill/n4 prior with four executable full ordered figure-pair archetypes extracted from every public input; shared color remapping and horizontal/vertical reflection provide lawful nuisance variation while preserving both answer-bearing occupancies; added canonical_profile_signature, is_canonical_profile, and rule_mirror; the signature retains grid dimensions, palette cardinality, coherent-region count, and both ordered binary crop masks while ignoring only placement and color labels; profile selection and all six exact axes now use separate keyed GenCtx draws without mutating ctx.overrides; unknown controls, invalid difficulty, coerced integer types, and invalid texture enums fail closed; explicit texture='none' is byte-identical to omission and is part of the declared/current 127-case matrix; texture='min_diff' records n_diff_rows through a feasible singleton choice, accepts compatible explicit 1, and rejects conflicting values; self_check now rejects diff rows with more than the declared seven XOR marks; added seven focused regression groups covering public pairs, complete-profile main/stability coverage, exact provenance, texture contracts, checker mutations, deterministic fresh returns, and global RNG isolation
summary: The top two big (>5 cell) 8-connected multicolor objects are cropped to their (same-dim) bboxes; the output has one row per row where the two crops differ IN VALUE, marking 8 at columns where exactly one crop is zero (zero/nonzero xor). Canonically the two figures are one shared picture built from coherent color regions (same-color 4-component count 13..32, fill 0.667..0.924) with zero-set edits in exactly 2-4 rows carrying 1..7 xor marks each, every scene having at least one multi-mark row.
